verses.54:20: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏

meaning: The root قعر (qEr) primarily refers to the bottom or lowest depth of something, like a well or a house. It can also metaphorically describe deep judgment or profound speech.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
